_notes: Single source of truth for the demo world. Read by scripts/seed_sandbox.py (PayPal sandbox orders) and by demo_sites (the mock merchant websites). Dates are offsets (days_ago) from the moment the mock sites are seeded. The demo logins below are public credentials for the fake sites only.

sections.heading: Orders returned to us undelivered
sections.text: If a carrier returns an order to us as undeliverable, we refund the full order total once the return scan appears on the carrier's tracking page. No action is needed from the customer.

sections.heading: Delivered without a signature
sections.text: Most orders ship without signature confirmation. When a first-time customer reports an order as not received but the carrier shows it delivered with no signature, we may offer a goodwill partial refund of up to 30% of the order total while we keep the carrier record on file. We do not refund in full on a delivery scan alone.

sections.heading: Repeat claims
sections.text: Customers with an earlier order on file are asked for more detail before any goodwill offer is made.

sections.heading: PayPal inquiries
sections.text: We respond to every PayPal inquiry inside the response window. Where the carrier record shows delivery to the address on the order, we may provide it as proof of delivery.
